answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 10 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The whisper multiplier is published, charged in hollow, and horizon lists each payment. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 4936 identities would post 4684 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
